name: verify_stockPackageType_audit_columns_by_id
note: stock_package_type: create/write uid and date per row (mail/chatter and the record's metadata read), keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, create_uid, write_uid, create_date, write_date FROM stock_package_type ORDER BY id

name: verify_stockPackageType_scalar_listing
note: stock_package_type: every int/string/bool column of every row as a list view reads it, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, sequence, sequence_id, company_id, name, barcode, package_use FROM stock_package_type ORDER BY id

name: verify_stockPackageType_embed_fanout_by_parent
note: stock_package_type: per-parent count of each embedded array (stock_package_type_stock_putaway_rule_rel, stock_package_type_stock_route_rel) against the child-row count, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT r.id, COALESCE(e0.n, 0) AS n_stockputawayrulerel, COALESCE(e1.n, 0) AS n_stockrouterel FROM stock_package_type r LEFT JOIN (SELECT stock_package_type_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_package_type_stock_putaway_rule_rel GROUP BY stock_package_type_id) e0 ON e0.pid = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT stock_package_type_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_package_type_stock_route_rel GROUP BY stock_package_type_id) e1 ON e1.pid = r.id ORDER BY r.id
